snippet.title: Nvidia Fell 4.99%. The Peace Rally Was Gone By The Close.
snippet.description:
Nvidia closed at 196.51, down 4.99%, and led the technology selling that erased the morning's peace-pause gap. The S&P 500 opened 52.22 points above Friday and finished just 1.20 points higher. The Nasdaq opened 260.36 points higher and closed 43.74 points below Friday.

The Associated Press reported the three-day pause in US-Iran attacks, and that Nvidia and Micron were major technology drags while most S&P 500 members finished higher: https://apnews.com/article/2b81f0e01bb318ae8d4281964f89f2f1

My read is that the portfolio test here is concentration. A technology-heavy account did not have the S&P 500's flat day. The deciding Nvidia range is 195.44 to 206.84, and the broad S&P 500 range is 7,382.74 to 7,480.57.

Research tooling, not financial advice. No performance is promised or implied.
